recognize_zh: 淋巴結髓質與副皮質被纖維血管背景中的三系造血細胞取代、皮質被擠壓，高倍可見成群、核深染且怪異的非典型巨核細胞（CD61 陽性），伴 CD71 紅系、MPO 髓系細胞與網狀纖維增生；型態與同一病人的骨髓骨髓纖維化相同。
features: Low power: lymph node with distorted architecture, pink fibrovascular tissue replacing medulla and paracortex and compressing residual cortex
Clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, bizarre, cloud-like or hypolobated nuclei
Admixed erythroid and granulocytic precursors in a fibrotic, vascular stroma
CD61 highlights clustered megakaryocytes; CD71 marks erythroid clusters; MPO shows scattered myeloid cells
Reticulin stain shows dense diffuse fibrosis in the node
Marrow panels: hypercellular fibrotic marrow with atypical megakaryocytes, increased reticulin and trichrome-positive collagen
describe_en: Axillary lymph node shows distorted architecture with the medulla and paracortex replaced by a fibrovascular proliferation containing trilineage hematopoietic cells, compressing the residual cortex. There are clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, bizarre nuclei that are CD61-positive, together with CD71-positive erythroid clusters and scattered MPO-positive myeloid cells; reticulin stain shows marked fibrosis, and CD34+ blasts are not increased. The concurrent bone marrow shows similar atypical megakaryocytes with reticulin and collagen fibrosis. Findings are consistent with lymph node involvement by primary myelofibrosis (neoplastic extramedullary hematopoiesis) with a mutational profile matching the marrow.

ddx.vs: Bizarre megakaryocytes can mimic pleomorphic tumor cells, but here they are CD61-positive and accompanied by erythroid and myeloid precursors rather than keratin-positive cells.
Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+/CD15+ and CD61-negative, set in an inflammatory rather than trilineage hematopoietic background.
Myeloid sarcoma consists of sheets of CD34+/CD117+ or MPO+ blasts, whereas blasts are not increased here.
Reactive EMH has cytologically normal megakaryocytes without clustering or dense fibrosis and lacks clonal MPN mutations.

stain: H&E; IHC: CD61, CD71, MPO; reticulin; trichrome
